case03_finding.raw_text: Summary: Invoice INV-03504 (Meridian Fasteners SUP-1001) dated 2026-08-28 references PO-2026-4003. PO shows 4000 x NUT-M8 @ 0.11 AUD (PO line total 440.00 AUD). Goods receipt GRN-2026-4003 confirms 4000 received. Extracted invoice line shows 4000 x NUT-M8 @ 0.12 AUD (unit price higher than PO). Calculations: invoice unit price 0.12 vs PO 0.11 → unit price variance = (0.12-0.11)/0.11 = 9.09% (exceeds policy tolerance 5%). PO total 440.00 AUD vs extracted invoice total 492.80 AUD → invoice is 52.80 AUD (12.0% of PO total) higher. Policy: POL-AP-001 permits up to 5% supplier-unfavourable price variance; this invoice exceeds that and must be escalated. Note: extracted arithmetic inconsistency — 0.12 * 4000 = 480.00 AUD, not 492.80 AUD — requires verifier to check the original PDF for additional charges (tax, freight) or re-run extraction. Recommendation: Escalate invoice for price-variance review per POL-AP-001 and verify the source invoice to resolve the line_total/total_amount mismatch before approving payment.
